findings.observation: An approved ledger can cite only one primary-reference row while declaring all three synthetic materials read. Other material representation/disposition and full reference line accounting are not mechanically required.
findings.limit: Complete semantic unit enumeration cannot be proven by line coverage. Do not infer a production omission from this synthetic acceptance.
findings.repair: Add exact per-material raw range disposition/read ledger, justify exclusions, and require semantic unit references to accounted ranges; retain AI semantic judgment and report it separately.

findings.observation: Covered unit with empty/nonexistent canonicalLocation passes; all canonical units may be scope-excluded with blank statement/reason and no references.
findings.repair: Use fixed canonical SHA plus exact existing heading/line ranges for represented units; require nonblank unit text/ID/reason and reasoned exclusion. This establishes location existence, not semantic completeness.

notPerformed: Semantic fidelity and whole-original unit completeness
